run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the discussion group CC'd
run_main: run the main function to invoke upload.py with the googlemock group added to the cc line
review_main: review the main function that parses sys.argv and appends the GMOCK_GROUP cc address before execv
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional cc group addresses beyond the single GMOCK_GROUP constant
summarize_main: summarize the main function which wraps upload.py by injecting --cc=googlemock@googlegroups.com into arguments
